hooks.command: grep -qiE 'build|implement|create|feature' && echo 'REMINDER: this looks like a feature build. Per AGENTS.md, run /architect first and confirm a plan before writing code.' || true

f=$(grep -oE '"file_path":"[^"]*"' | head -1); printf '%s' "$f" | grep -qiE 'components/|[.]tsx"' && printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"REMINDER: you edited a UI component. Run /imprint to capture its patterns into ui-registry.md before finishing (first run on this project: /imprint audit)."}}' || true

grep -qE '"stop_hook_active":[[:space:]]*true' && exit 0; printf '%s' '{"decision":"block","reason":"REMINDER: if this turn changed code, append an entry to the matching file in frontend/context/engineering/ (frontend/backend/database/auth-security/ai/ai-agents/mcp .md). Follow the SAME format as existing entries: What/Where/Why PLUS a Learn block (vocabulary if needed -> naive-vs-good code -> plain-english why -> where-else-you-would-use-it -> rule of thumb), per context/engineering/README.md. Pure facts stay terse with a (no lesson) note. Perf items only after approval. If it was pure discussion with no code change, nothing to log - just stop."}'
